stem: In the context of the 'Jones criteria', which condition includes arthritis as one of its major clinical markers?
explanation: Rheumatic fever is a post-streptococcal reactive process where arthritis is a major diagnostic criterion.
rationale: Recall the specific systemic disease linked to Group A Streptococcus mentioned in the lecture.

optionExplanations.A: Septic arthritis is an acute infection and is not part of the Jones criteria.
optionExplanations.B: Rheumatic fever is a post-streptococcal reactive process where arthritis is a major diagnostic criterion.
optionExplanations.C: This is a benign post-viral condition unrelated to the Jones criteria for streptococcal complications.
optionExplanations.D: This is a pediatric malignancy and is not diagnosed using criteria related to streptococcal infections.
